subject: Post-call: FinTechCo production errors — capacity & deployment options
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@fintechco.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-31T15:07:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: FinTechCo production errors — capacity & deployment options

Alice — thanks for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned.

What we heard (from your SRE notes / on-call):
- Intermittent 502/timeout spikes during your nightly billing run (peak concurrency ~6500 reqs/min).
- Token throttling and increased tail latencies around 1.5–2s p95 for generation endpoints.
- KV-cache cold-starts on long-tail requests; prefix/cache-miss pattern consistent with short-lived sessions.

High-level options (tradeoffs):
- Hosted API (short-term): we can provision emergency capacity increases and raise rate limits; fastest to get immediate relief but subject to shared-hosted accounting and per-token billing spikes.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): predictable throughput, isolated GPU pools, better tail latency and predictable cost per token. Good near-term production fix if you need sustained headroom.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): necessary if you need VPC peering, strict data residency, or procurement/legal constraints. Longer lead time.

Asks / constraints we need from you:
1) Priorities: latency SLO (p95 target), cost ceiling, and whether VPC/networking is a hard requirement.
2) Procurement timeline: is six weeks acceptable for procurement, or do you need a faster path?
3) Permission to pull a 2-hour sampling window of logs (we will redact PII) to run a sizing exercise.

Next steps (proposed):
- Redwood to run a lightweight sizing analysis (Neha) and provide a Dedicated capacity proposal + cost estimate within 48 hours.
- If you confirm VPC is required, we’ll include Private deployment timelines and checklist (longer lead time).
- Schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive for tomorrow (available slots: 10:00–13:00 PT).

I’ve attached a current Dedicated pricing snapshot and our SOC2 summary for your security/compliance team to review.

If this aligns, please confirm the preferred time for the technical session and whether we have a green light to fetch the 2-hour logs.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-pricing-v2.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_summary_2025.pdf

From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@fintechco.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops+infra@fintechco.com
Date: 2026-05-31T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinTechCo production errors — capacity & deployment options

Thanks, Aditya — good recap. A couple clarifications from our side:
- This hit production during a monthly billing aggregation job. The incident caused retries across downstream systems; we had to roll back a DAG and it cost us ~2 hours of degraded metrics.
- Immediate ask: we need isolation (either Dedicated or Private). Shared-hosted is no longer acceptable for this workload given predictable nightly peaks.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 report, encryption at rest, and VPC peering are mandatory if we go Private.
- Procurement: we can move quickly but procurement timelines are often ~4–6 weeks for anything that requires an SOW or PO. We will prioritize this if Redwood can provide an expedited quote + legal terms.

I’ll pull the incident logs and share a 2-hour window (redacted) by EOD. Please include a named point of contact for technical intake.

— Alice
Alice Wu, Director of SRE, FinTechCo
alice.wu@fintechco.com

Attachment: incident_log_0531.zip

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@fintechco.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinTechCo production errors — capacity & deployment options

Appreciate the quick reply and the incident log — that will help. Looping in Neha (Solutions Eng) and Tessa (Sales Ops) to kick off sizing and procurement.

Immediate plan from Redwood:
1) Neha to run a prefix- and traffic-distribution analysis on the 2-hour window and produce a Dedicated sizing recommendation (target delivery: 24 hours).
2) Tessa to prepare an expedited quote and outline procurement/legal path (DocuSign MSA vs PO options) and list items we need to speed approval.
3) Technical deep-dive: propose 2026-06-01 at 11:00 PT for a 45-min session. Confirm if this works.

Attaching the updated Dedicated pricing snapshot and SOC2 summary for your CISO. If you want an initial ballpark before the sizing run, we can provide a not-to-exceed (NTE) monthly figure based on conservative concurrency.

Neha / Tessa — please prioritize this as P1. Customer has production impact and prefers Dedicated or Private; they require SOC2 and VPC peering if we go Private.

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: FinTechCo sizing & procurement (urgent)

Quick internal notes and asks — forwarding customer snippets below for context.

> "Immediate ask: we need isolation (either Dedicated or Private). Shared-hosted is no longer acceptable for this workload given predictable nightly peaks."
> "Security/compliance: SOC2 report, encryption at rest, and VPC peering are mandatory if we go Private."

Technical assumptions / recommendation (first pass):
- Target concurrency: assume 7k reqs/min at peak; average token generation length 180 tokens; estimated sustained qps ~120 rps across inference endpoints.
- Suggested starting Dedicated config: 8x A100-equivalent slots (continuous), KV cache warmers enabled, autoscale headroom to add 50% burst capacity. This should bring p95 generation latency <700ms in our internal benchmarks.
- Timeline: Dedicated pool spin-up (provisioning + model onboarding) ~7 business days if we have logs and a signed order; Private VPC adds 10–15 business days depending on security onboarding and network approvals.
- Discounts: offer a reserved 6- or 12-month commit with tiered discounts; include emergency burst credits for the first 30 days during cutover.

Neha: can you run the sizing run and provide a concrete tokens/sec estimate and recommended slot count? Also prepare a small test harness (replay) we can run against a staging Dedicated pool.
Tessa: start the quote build and flag any legal items required for expedited DocuSign route; notify finance for any interim credit options.
Lauren: loop in solutions architecture if we need a tailored kernel/quantization recommendation for the customer's model.

I’ll join the technical deep-dive if needed. Aim: have an internal demoable Dedicated pool and quote ready for the customer within 48 hours.

— Aditya

From: ops+infra@fintechco.com <ops+infra@fintechco.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@fintechco.com
Date: 2026-06-01T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinTechCo production errors — capacity & deployment options

Aditya / team — thanks for the rapid coordination. We’ve reviewed your initial notes and the SOC2 summary. To confirm: FinTechCo will prioritize a Dedicated deployment. Required items from Redwood to proceed:
1) Formal quote (line items: reserved capacity, burst credits, onboarding services) and an expedited 30-day SOW/PO path.
2) SOC2 attestations and any additional security docs (KMS integration notes, encryption at rest).
3) Proposed cutover plan and rollback playbook (we need to minimize disruption during our monthly run).
4) Legal: can we get an expedited MSA via DocuSign? Procurement contact is procurement@fintechco.com.

Timeline is urgent — if Redwood can provide a formal quote + SOW by EOD tomorrow and a technical readiness window next week, we will expedite approvals on our side. Also confirm whether Redwood can offer any incident credits for the service disruption that occurred during the outage.

Regards,
FinTechCo Ops Team
ops+infra@fintechco.com
